channel.title: Harbor Line notices (demo)
channel.description: Demo feed made for a G2 Digest video. Every item is invented; none of it is news.

item.title: Night service on the Harbor Line becomes permanent from Friday
item.description: After the summer trial, trains run all night on Fridays and every night from 7 November, with shorter trains between 01:00 and 05:00.

item.title: Platform 2 at Quay Street repainted
item.description: Repainting at Quay Street platform 2 is finished. No change to service.
